parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, maximum phase, molecule types, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by the document ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
